header.title: Our Team
header.description: Meet the people behind i18n Benchmark. A diverse team united by a shared passion for great developer tools.

grid.member1Bio: Former Google engineer with 10 years of experience building internationalization systems at scale.
grid.member2Bio: Specializes in JavaScript performance optimization and benchmarking methodology. Previously at Vercel.
grid.member3Bio: Passionate about developer experience and education. Speaker at React Conf, JSConf, and i18nNext.
grid.member4Bio: Maintains the benchmarking infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline. Open source contributor to Lingui.
grid.member5Bio: Ensures statistical rigor in all benchmark results. PhD in Applied Statistics from MIT.
grid.member6Bio: Manages community contributions, partnerships, and events. Background in open source governance.
